notes.title: Early Access Build 7
notes.content:
[h1]Indicators[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Added waypoint indicators: displays the current move destination for the active warship; hold the Shift key to view the waypoint queue
[*]     Added a port/starboard indicator around the active warship to help with aiming broadsides
[/list]
[h1]Hotkeys[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Added hotkeys for prepare broadside ability (port [ , ], reset [ . ], starboard [ / ])
[/list]
[h1]Campaign[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Campaign missions now default to tactics mode (i.e. ships are controllable; uses the strategy camera instead of close-up camera)
[/list]
[h1]
Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Health and damage numbers have been adjusted to a higher base level to allow more room in the future for balancing
[*]     Added new Armor attribute into damage calculation formula
[/list]
[h1]Music[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Added military strategy OST to the game
[/list]
[h1]Options[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Added new setting for music volume
[/list]
[h1]Versus[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Begin transitioning Fleet Builder, Scenario Options, and Formation Editor to independent menus
[*]     Added tooltips to the Scenario Options menu
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Fix an issue where the turret would fail to shoot if selected via hotkey after pressing the minimap
[*]     Fix an issue where mouse hover sound effects would play for menu items obscured behind a modal
[*]     Fix an issue where the system mouse cursor sometimes displayed instead of the in-game mouse cursor
[*]     Fix an issue where the selection indicator displayed slightly off-center
[*]     Fix an issue where the viewport would fail to capture the mouse in a multi-monitor setup
[*]     Fix an issue where Team 2 would fail to earn points for sunk boats or turret hits
[*]     [Multiplayer] Fix a potential soft lock when rapdily changing between overseer view and turret mode
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 5
notes.content:
[h3]Versus Battle[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fleet Battle is renamed to Versus Battle
[/list]
[h3]New Game Mode Selection[/h3]
[list]
[*] Joust: ships travel “on rails” on a predetermined line. Accuracy and orientation are key. This is the original game mode.
[*] Tactics: enables setting waypoints for ship movements, similar to real-time strategy (RTS) style controls. More control at the expense of increased responsibility.
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prepare Broadsides ability: instantly align all turrets on a warship to port, starboard, or the start position
[*] Click to select: clicking any eligible friendly warship on the screen will now possess that ship
[*] Hits counter: the number of successful hits now displays for the selected warship in the HUD
[*] Note: a direct hit = 2, glancing blow = 1
[/list]
[h3]Misc Additions & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved graphics: the material textures on ships have been revised to a higher quality/level of detail
[*] Fix some minor visual issues in the Change Allegiance menu (Campaign)
[*] Fix an error with the camera during level selection (Campaign)
[*] Fix a defect that would occasionally cause the camera to teleport to the water surface level during binocular mode
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implement tactics mode option for multiplayer battles
[*] Fix an issue where teammates could inadvertently change their ally’s camera view when changing turrets on a possessed ship
[*] Fix an issue where selection circles would fail to clear when possessing a new unit (Tactics)
[/list]
[h3]
Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] (Multiplayer) Statistics (i.e. score, hits, accuracy) count fails to properly display for non-hosting players (doesn’t affect victory conditions)
[*] The dreadnought broadside ability can cause side turrets to aim at an angle that is not normally possible
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 4 - Multiplayer is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Fleet Battle[/h2]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] New multiplayer option comes to Fleet Battles.
[*] Host or join sessions over LAN or Internet (Steam). 
[*] Play games of up to 8 players, with 2 opposing fleets
[*] For the first release, teams are automatically assigned and the fleets are chosen from the first 2 players.
[*] For games of 3 or more players, players will be grouped onto teams where they can individually control different turrets and share the victory objective
[*] Create a player profile (name, avatar) and join together in a chat-enabled lobby before playing
[/list]
[h2]Campaign[/h2]
[list]
[*] Change Allegiance mode: the player can now choose sides between the Royal Navy and Imperial Fleet during the campaign battles
[/list]
[h2]Various Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Expanded implementation of gamepad controls (specifically during gameplay)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Early Access Build 2
notes.content:
[i]*Alas, the sounds of war have upset a mythical beast from the depths!*[/i]

[h2]New[/h2]
- Final boss fight in the North Sea campaign (re-clear 3rd mission to unlock)
- New Game + is a more difficult, timed mode
- Begin internal implementation of scenario feature
- Very limited and partial gamepad controller support
- (PC) (Graphics) Additional post-processing effects
- (PC) (Performance) Removed frame rate smoothing and removed the frame rate cap

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where turret rotation speed was affected by FPS
- Fixed a typo that displayed in the flavor text of the first mission
- Fixed an issue where a level unlock could fail to be saved
- Improved aesthetics, size, and layout of multiple menus and HUD
- (PC) Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would sometimes fail to display in the main menu
- (iOS) Fixed issues with menu items being inaccessible on screens with rounded corners

Proceed to the [url=https://www.fallingninja.com/games/ruler-of-the-waves-1916]the product page[/url] for links to download the game.
